title: Bronze Statuette of Zeus (Jupiter)
subject: Zeus/Jupiter, seated, as lord of the sky
description: A Roman bronze statuette of Zeus (Jupiter), the sky-father. Roman copies preserve the iconography of the Greek Zeus: bearded, seated, often with scepter and thunderbolt.

title: Glass Head of Zeus Sarapis
subject: Zeus Sarapis, the syncretic Greco-Egyptian god
